description: This file defines a Java interface 'FileGet' that specifies methods for retrieving static content from a Content Management System (CMS), including methods to get files, file names, and lists of files based on merchant store code and content type.

classes.name: FileGet
classes.description: Java interface defining methods to retrieve static content from the CMS, including getting individual files, file names, and lists of files based on store code and content type.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a specific content file for a given merchant store code and content type, identified by content name, possibly throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getFileNames
methods.description: Retrieves a list of file names for a given merchant store code and content type, possibly throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of content files for a given merchant store code and content type, possibly throwing a ServiceException.
